sentences: A monochromatic rectangle in a matrix selects rows and columns whose intersecting entries all have one value.
The source asks about finding or guaranteeing such rectangles when the matrix has low rank.
Rank constrains algebraic dependence, whereas a rectangle requires a particularly rigid combinatorial pattern.
Relating the two could improve structural tools used in exact algorithms and communication-style arguments.
